free_tier_limits.correction: Not applicable for an ongoing free tier. Persona offers a no-card 60-day Essential trial with up to 50 services, Sandbox-only by default.

rate_limits.correction: The default production-environment limit is 300 API requests per minute; additional product-specific quotas may apply and are shown in the Dashboard.
